plugins.name: QR Code Generator
plugins.description: Got a link? Make a QR for it in a sec. We keep the ones you make, so you can find them back.

plugins.name: Card Wallet
plugins.description: All your stamp cards and member passes in one spot. Scan them with your camera and show them at the till, right from your screen.

plugins.name: File Tree
plugins.description: Wondering where all your space went? This shows you, biggest folders first, with handy little bars.

plugins.name: File Viewer
plugins.description: Just open the file. PDFs, Word, Excel, pictures, code - it shows it, no other apps needed.

plugins.name: Errand Manager
plugins.description: Those little jobs that keep coming back, in one tidy list for today. Say how often they return, snooze the ones you skip.

plugins.name: Bulletin Board
plugins.description: A pinboard for your head. Stick notes, pictures and little to-dos on it, however you like.

plugins.name: Price Tracker
plugins.description: Paste a link and we will keep an eye on the price for you. Handy when you are waiting for a deal on Amazon or bol.

plugins.name: Calendar
plugins.description: Your days, at a glance. Pop in what is happening, give it a colour, set it to repeat if it comes back.

plugins.name: Cloud Files
plugins.description: Your files, on all your devices. Locked on your device before they leave, so only you can read them. Sign in under Settings, Sync and account, to use it.

plugins.name: Data Management
plugins.description: Make your own little tables and turn them into charts. Bring a CSV if you have got one.

plugins.name: Server Hosting Tycoon
plugins.description: Run your own little server company for fun. Buy computers, keep them cool, take on jobs and grow day by day.

plugins.name: Mood Journal
plugins.description: How was today, really? Jot it down and spot patterns over time.

plugins.name: Steam Tools
plugins.description: Your Steam games with real price history. See what a game cost, what it costs now, and if it is actually a good deal. Your key never leaves your device.

plugins.name: AI Usage
plugins.description: See what your AI tools cost you, which models are good, and which ones your own PC could run. All read from your laptop, nothing sent away.

plugins.name: AI Detector
plugins.description: Paste some text, see if it reads like a person wrote it or not. Just maths, no AI, and nothing leaves your device.

plugins.name: Media Downloader
plugins.description: Save a YouTube video or just the sound for later. Paste a Spotify song and we will find the sound for you, title and cover kept tidy.

plugins.name: Subway Builder
plugins.description: Build trams, metros and buses in any city on Earth, on a real map. Real streets, real stations - will people ditch the car for you?

plugins.name: Space Colony
plugins.description: Start a little town on a far-away planet. Keep the lights on, grow food, look after air and water, and hold on when meteors show up.

plugins.name: City Planner
plugins.description: Start with a tiny village and grow it into a big city. Draw your own buildings, sort out traffic, power, water, schools and taxes.

plugins.name: Auto Clicker
plugins.description: Tired of clicking? Let this click for you. Pick where, how fast, and which mouse button.

plugins.name: School
plugins.description: All your school stuff in one place. Homework, flashcards, timers, grades, timetables - the lot.

plugins.name: Usage
plugins.description: Where does your day go? See which apps you actually used and for how long, in simple charts.

plugins.name: Wi-Fi Speed Test
plugins.description: How fast is your internet right now? One tap and you will see. We keep old tests so you can compare.

plugins.name: Chat
plugins.description: Chat with another luma person. Locked on your device before it is sent, so only you two can read it. Sign in under Settings, Sync and account, to start.

plugins.name: Groceries List
plugins.description: Look up groceries at Jumbo, AH, Lidl and the rest side by side. Lists that sort themselves by shop and aisle. Nova only.

plugins.name: SFTP
plugins.description: Move files to your own servers, the easy way. Your PC and your server next to each other - just drag stuff over. Nothing goes through us. Nova only.

plugins.name: Minecraft Launcher
plugins.description: Play Minecraft your way. Set up Vanilla, Fabric, Forge and friends, add mods and packs, and hit play.

plugins.name: Recipe Book
plugins.description: Keep your favourite recipes with photos. Keep them to yourself, or share them so other luma cooks can try and rate them.

plugins.name: Calculator
plugins.description: A calculator for quick sums that can also draw graphs. Plus a handy converter for km to miles, C to F and more.

plugins.name: Gallery
plugins.description: All your photos and videos, tidied up. Camera stuff, screenshots, GIFs, WhatsApp - each in its own spot, with a map of where you took them.

plugins.name: Transport Tracker
plugins.description: Watch ships move around the world, live. Wander around the map and see what is sailing nearby. Just add a free AISStream key.

plugins.name: NFC Tag Editor
plugins.description: Read those little NFC stickers and write your own. Links, Wi-Fi, contact cards - save a set and write a whole batch. Android only.

plugins.name: Roblox Tools
plugins.description: Little helpers for your Roblox games. First up: Mafia - see which roles are in play and tick them off as you go.

plugins.name: Worth Counter
plugins.description: Counting stock? Add what it is worth, tap + and - as you count, and see the total grow at the bottom.

plugins.name: Device Health
plugins.description: How is your PC doing? CPU, memory, battery, updates - check one thing or everything at once. Windows only. We just ask Windows itself.

plugins.name: Account Overview
plugins.description: Your GitHub and Minecraft stuff in one dashboard. Commits, stars, downloads, views - no digging through five websites. Keys stay on your device.

plugins.name: Mind Map
plugins.description: Get the mess out of your head. Start in the middle, hit Tab for a new branch, Enter for the next thought. No dragging boxes around.

plugins.name: Machine Learning
plugins.description: Draw a shape and watch it teach itself to walk 50 metres. Sixty try at once, the best ones have children, and a few hundred generations later something is walking.
